Choices B and C use covalent bonds and evaporative cooling, both explicitly covered in EK 1.1.A.1. Choice D mentions density but is a distractor that can be rejected based on the correct in-scope mechanism; it does not require knowledge of an out-of-scope concept to eliminate. No internal inconsistencies are present.
